coverage.boundaries: The shared checker covered each actual control's default and minimum/maximum or first/last select option. The separate tests use the actual eight demos and frozen prefix-only traces with throwing result/scene/visual getters, without repeating a full endpoint sweep.

scope: Linear classification: both input pixels, all four weight cells and both biases, every class-feature multiplication, both score sums, explicit tie-to-class-zero rule, and every perturbed-input multiplication and score.

Softmax: each original logit, fixed label and positive temperature, temperature-scaled logits, stable maximum shift, each exponential and normalization denominator, every class probability, true-class cross entropy, every one-hot target and raw-logit gradient including the chain-rule factor 1/T.

Backpropagation: weighted input, preactivation, ReLU, signed prediction error and half-square loss, each local derivative and chain-rule product, actual central-difference perturbations/losses, smooth-interval guard and explicitly non-certifying comparison at the ReLU kink.

Convolution: all nine image and four kernel cells, each of the sixteen multiplication terms across four unflipped correlation windows, all four output sums, each ReLU cell, full-window pool candidates, maximum, spatial width and shared-parameter count.

Residual connection: identity and residual paths, scalar output sum, plain and shortcut input-gradient contributions, combined input derivative, numerical cancellation tolerance and the w=-1 counterexample.

Attention: all three scalar keys and values, current query, each scaled dot-product score, stable exponentials and normalization, every attention weight and weighted-value term, scalar output and convex-value bound.

Detection: every coordinate and supplied score of both continuous boxes, intersection width/height and area, both box areas, union and IoU, score ordering, strict NMS suppression predicate, per-box membership and retained count.

Transfer/evaluation: every supplied feature, object identity and label, every head score and thresholded prediction, each training/validation index, explicit per-object overlap, each validation correctness term, accuracy and independent-group flag.

checks: Every actual default demo frame has unique semantic scalar cells and can inspect only the current trace prefix; traces are frozen and result/scene/visual access throws.
All eight experiments use registered controls, change actual parameters, verify concrete outcomes, retain trace immutability, and reject corrupted outputs and unapplied changes.
Biased linear-score equality selects class zero and input perturbation preserves the weights.
Temperature-scaled probabilities and all three raw-logit derivatives agree with independent finite differences, including the 1/T factor.
The ReLU kink uses the explicit zero derivative while central difference crosses the kink; active and zero-input cases check separate branches.
Independent four-window correlation arithmetic checks unflipped-kernel signs, sixteen individual products, ReLU and whole-window max pooling.
Residual input derivative agrees with independent perturbation; zero input is distinct from w=-1 gradient cancellation.
Uniform and nonuniform query cases check every attention weight and weighted-value contribution against an independent exponential formula.
Continuous-box geometry gives area without coordinate plus-one; an exact IoU=0.6 threshold equality preserves both boxes and a lower threshold suppresses B.
A head-weight case with errors checks group and row validation accuracy independently from object overlap; both A and B cross the row split.

limits: These are original finite topic exercises for the current eight-lesson catalog, not a complete official CS231n course, realistic image recognizer or evidence of model training.
All models retain four actual computation stages. Individual tensor cells are expanded within their generating stage without adding artificial playback frames.
The classifier, softmax and backpropagation examples are single-sample calculations with fixed labels or weights as stated; no optimizer, dataset accuracy or probability calibration is claimed.
The ReLU derivative at exactly zero is an implementation convention. A central-difference interval touching the kink is explicitly excluded from smooth derivative certification.
Correlation uses a single input/output channel, a fixed 2x2 kernel, stride one, no padding and no bias. Pooling has no trainable weights; pooling backward/argmax tie routing is not implemented.
The residual branch is linear and scalar. Its cancellation example cannot establish gradient behavior in a full ResNet.
Attention uses one scalar query, three supplied scalar keys/values, no positional encoding, no causal mask, no learned projection, and no multihead or transformer training.
NMS concerns exactly two same-class continuous-coordinate boxes with fixed scores. It does not implement cross-class policy, truth matching, recall or AP.

Transfer features are supplied manually and the head weight is a control rather than a fitted parameter. No pretrained model is loaded. Absence of shared object IDs does not establish independence of time, scenes or pretraining data.
Formula text uses four decimal places; very small fixed difference steps/tolerances use scientific notation to avoid displaying them as zero. Numeric cells and verification retain full precision.
Only the course provider, its dedicated test and this manifest were authored. No shared models, configuration, UI, builds, browser state, records, receipts, completion or study minutes were changed.
